parole.significato: jackal, one of certain canids of the genus Canis
parole.testo: Borrowed from another European language, ultimately from Turkish çakal, from Persian شغال (šaġâl), from Sanskrit सृगाल (sṛgālá, “jackal”). Modified into the current form by folk etymology.
Borrowed from Turkish tülbent, from Ottoman Turkish دلبند (dülbend), from Persian دلبند (dolband). The second element was adapted to band by folk etymology. Doublet of tulp.
